title_zh: 约定离婚后的陪伴不追问前伴侣

scenario.label_zh: 离婚期间商定朋友陪伴的方式
scenario.goal_zh: 表达支持和个人意愿并约定安静见面而不谈论前伴侣

context_zh: 虚构朋友罗莎和贝丝谈论离婚后的情绪及陪伴边界。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: You've seemed distant lately. Have I done something to upset you?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: No. Since the divorce, every conversation seems to turn into questions about my former husband.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I'm sorry. I thought asking showed that I cared.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: I know. I have no desire to discuss what went wrong tonight. I just miss spending ordinary time with you.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I understand. You deserve some space without having to explain yourself.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: It's been a disappointment that some friends only call when they want news.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: Would you like to come over for tea tomorrow? We can talk about something else, or not talk much at all.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Yes, that would be lovely. And please don't pass on anything about him unless I ask.

sentences.speaker: Rosa
sentences.text: I won't. Just tea and company tomorrow.

targets.sense_zh: 疏远的；感情上不亲近的
